name: CleanShot X
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For CleanShot X, capture screenshots or screen video, annotate them, and copy or save locally. The hard boundary is deep macos integration, scrolling capture, cloud sharing, and years of polish, plus capture polish, hosting, and collaboration.
